• You serve and guide our rollers professionally and safely

• You ensure the uniform and professional compaction of asphalt coverings

• You work closely with the manufacturing team, the polisher and other machinists

• You continuously control the quality of the work carried out

• You perform minor maintenance and maintenance work on your machine

• You pay attention to a safe and careful handling of machines and equipment

• You can also support the construction team with further work if necessary

What matters to us

• Experience as a roller driver: in road and surface construction

• Safe and responsible handling of construction machinery
